value.rationale: Complete characteristic-two solution for the natural infinite family of split square-zero unital local algebras, a motivated boundary in a recent all-characteristic embedding theory. It proves explicit optimal envelopes and exhibits an unbounded 2r gap to the naive characteristic-two squaring-map rank, explaining structurally the failure of the paper’s char-not-two Waring bridge. No claim of general ring classification.
